scope: Black Americans, including people of the Black diaspora from the Caribbean, Latin America, Canada and Europe, and Americans whose parents came from those places. People born on the African continent are outside this page’s scope.
counting: Each person is counted once per line, in the year of their first recorded founding or patent/invention.
